detail.longDescription: AI agents leave behind more than useful work. NatashaTheRobot wrote about stale memory and context bloat, and it hit home: I found 600 GB of logs from agent-assisted testing! My always-on agents also revive decisions I've already rejected. As someone who relies on agents for accessibility and development, I want better cleanup and memory management, not another job babysitting AI. Read: https://www. natashatherobot.com/ # AIAgents # Accessibility
